_meta.paper_carrwu: Carr, P. & Wu, L. (2009) 'Variance Risk Premiums', Review of Financial Studies, 22(3), pp. 1311-1341
_meta.paper_bollerslev: Bollerslev, T., Tauchen, G. & Zhou, H. (2009) 'Expected Stock Returns and Variance Risk Premia', Review of Financial Studies, 22(11), pp. 4463-4492
_meta.equation_expost: VRP_t = IV_t^2 - RV_t (ex-post proxy, Carr & Wu 2009)
_meta.equation_conditional: VRP_t = IV_t^2 - E[RV_{t+1}|F_t] (conditional, Bollerslev 2009 — requires forecast model)
_meta.implementation_note: compute_vrp in features/options.py implements the ex-post proxy (Carr & Wu). iv_features.py uses HAR-based E[RV] for conditional VRP when sufficient data is available.

simple_case.computation: VRP = IV^2 - RV = 0.04 - 0.03 = 0.01 (positive = variance seller earns premium)

negative_vrp.computation: VRP = IV^2 - RV = 0.02 - 0.05 = -0.03 (negative = realized vol exceeded implied)

zero_vrp.computation: VRP = IV^2 - RV = 0.04 - 0.04 = 0.0 (implied matched realized exactly)
